trigger.what: Supplier K submitted a formal price notice of +8.0% across 14 SKUs, effective Jan 1 under the 90-day clause.
Should-Cost Model reran the build-up from steel, freight and labour indices and returned +2.9% for the same basket.
Scorecard Engine flagged two other suppliers outside tier floors and pinned all three to one card rather than three.

constraints.label: Current contract terms
constraints.detail: Supplier K runs to Mar 31 with a 90-day price-change notice and a 500-unit MOQ. Nothing decided here overrides a signed term before it expires.

constraints.label: Strategic-supplier flags
constraints.detail: K and A are flagged strategic: exit requires exec sign-off, and no exit is executed inside a quarter without a qualified alternate already producing.

constraints.label: Open POs
constraints.detail: $412K across 9 POs is committed. Any transition honours them in full — no cancellation to gain negotiating position.

constraints.label: One conversation per supplier
constraints.detail: Realify drafts the counter and the message. A person sends it. No supplier ever receives anything Realify generated without a human reading it first.
